description: Enhanced edge coverage for callback-fragment parsing, disjoint from the native suite: a pair with no '=' (key maps to an empty value), a duplicate key where the last occurrence wins, a trailing '&' producing a spurious empty-key entry, an explicitly empty value, a realistic provider error fragment whose values keep their raw percent-encoding (no decoding), a leading '=' producing an empty-key/non-empty-value entry, and a full success fragment mixing a base64 token ending in '==', a dotted id_token, and a state value containing multiple '=' characters.
